author: Ankit
problem: Read N, M, a string S of length N and a string T of length M (N <= M). Print 0 if S is both a prefix and a suffix of T, 1 if it is only a prefix, 2 if it is only a suffix, and 3 if it is neither.
bug_description: Case 0 checks T == S instead of S being both a prefix and a suffix, so a longer T that starts and ends with S gets 1.

comments.accurate: Prints 0, 1, 2 or 3 depending on whether S is a prefix and/or a suffix of T
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints 0 when T is exactly S, otherwise 1 for a prefix, 2 for a suffix and 3 for neither
comments.wrong_location: Case 0 check verified; check the suffix slice T[-N:] when N equals M

source.fixed_line: if T[:N] == S and T[-N:] == S:
